name: Cast Iron Plant
hook: Dim room killing plants? Try a cast iron plant.

steps.title: Low light, no direct sun
steps.tip: A north window or dim corner suits it. Direct sun scorches the leaves; deep shade just slows growth.

steps.title: Water when 5–8 cm is dry
steps.tip: Water once the top 5–8 cm is dry and empty the saucer. Soggy compost rots roots; water less in winter.

steps.title: Cool is fine
steps.tip: Keep it between 5 and 20°C, away from radiators and other heat sources.

steps.title: Feed monthly in summer
steps.tip: General houseplant feed once a month, from spring to late summer only.

steps.title: Dust and check leaves
steps.tip: Wipe leaves with a damp cloth and check weekly for spider mites, mealybugs and scale.

steps.title: Divide in spring
steps.tip: Cut through the rhizomes of a big clump, keeping several leaves on each piece.

outro: Shade, a little water and no fuss: it just keeps going.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Aspidistra elatior
